value.rationale: The paper explicitly distinguishes unimodal and non-unimodal ratio laws but leaves the exact reciprocal peak geometry unspecified. The full two-peak classification is a natural shape invariant for all N; the exact Rayleigh tilt enables reproducible mode localization and the explicit ζ(3) shift supplies a genuine boundary-sensitive asymptotic. The gap between vanishing modal density locations and exponentially diverging almost-sure typical magnitudes is substantive for interpreting heavy-tailed reciprocal-product models, not a normalization check or arbitrary finite table. No general downstream guarantee is claimed.
